field.label: List groups
field.help: Comma separated list group names this schedule applies to. Those groups are only active during the window below; outside it they are inactive (not blocking).

field.label: Weekdays
field.help: Days of the week the window applies to.

field.label: Start
field.help: Start of the window (24-hour HH:MM). Leave both Start and End empty for an all-day schedule (the selected weekdays only).

field.label: End
field.help: End of the window (24-hour HH:MM). If Start is later than End, the window spans midnight (overnight). Must be set together with Start.
